text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT INC24680 - high severity - auth token verification errors ramping. Pager: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC24680 - triggered by token-verify 5xx/401 rate spike.

tom.h: ack - I'm oncall and looking.

anita.p: i'm seeing deploy of auth-signer v3.2.5 ~22m ago. That deploy included rotating to a new `SIGNER_KEY_ALIAS`.

marc_r: metrics: verification_failure_rate 401s jumped from baseline 0.6% -> 10% in ap-southeast-1, 7% in us-east-1. Latency for auth verification increased slightly.

sre-oncall: grabbing logs now. Quick grep shows repeating message: `verify: kid not found (kid=ks-A12B) - rejecting token` and signer logs show `published_kid=ks-A12B but jwks_keys contains ks-OLD1, ks-OLD2`.

ops-bot: fetch jwks: `curl -sS https://auth-internal.prod/well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'` -> returns ["ks-OLD1","ks-OLD2"]

anita.p: here's exact log lines: ```
ERROR token-verify - verify failure: no jwks entry for kid=ks-A12B
INFO auth-signer - key rotation completed, active_kid=ks-A12B, published=true
```

marc_r: hypothesis: rotation applied to signer instances but JWKS cache or propagation to verification fleet lagged. Possibly CDN edge cache TTL preventing new JWKS from reaching verifiers.

tom.h: mitigation plan: 1) force JWKS cache purge at edge layers, 2) roll back signer to previous key alias if purge not effective, 3) stop further signer rollouts. I'm doing purge now.

ops-bot: issued purge: `aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id XXXXXX --paths "/.well-known/jwks.json"` -> invalidation id INV-7890 started.

marc_r: after invalidation, verification errors dropped to ~3% in ap-southeast-1. Progressing.

anita.p: starting controlled rollback of SIGNER_KEY_ALIAS in us-east-1 (kubectl set env on auth-signer deployment). Command: ```
kubectl set env deployment/auth-signer SIGNER_KEY_ALIAS=ks-OLD -n prod
```

tom.h: holding further rollouts until we confirm JWKS propagation and add gating. Also disabling automated key-rotation job for now.

incident-bot: INC24680 acknowledged by tom.h - escalation paused.

support-bot: created support task SUP-5123 to surface top impacted tenants and prepare incident notification. Link: https://support.internal/SUP-5123

marc_r: quick customer impact: several enterprise Dedicated customers in APAC saw auth failures for management API calls; public API impact small but present (fallbacks triggered for a subset of requests). No token theft indicators.

anita.p: cross-check: JWKS cache timeouts show CDN cached old JWKS for 30m due to TTL=1800s and some edges not honoring invalidation immediately. Adding a short-circuit to verifiers to fetch origin JWKS on 401 if kid unknown. Implementing now as stopgap.

tom.h: test token workflow after rollback: generate new token via signer -> call /token/verify -> success. Running regression across regions.

marc_r: trailing errors trend down to baseline across us-east-1 and ap-southeast-1 after rollback + invalidation. us-west-1 had very small blip but unaffected by config.

tom.h: preparing handoff. I'll watch metrics for 20 more minutes then hand to night oncall anita.p at 01:00 UTC. If anything reappears escalate immediately.

anita.p: acknowledged handoff. I'll pick this up at 01:00 UTC.

marc_r: created postmortem shell: https://docs.internal/incidents/INC24680 - adding timeline and initial findings.

tom.h: preliminary root cause: key rotation reached signer before JWKS propagation completed to verification fleet (edge caches + missing deploy gating). Secondary cause: deploy pipeline didn't block rotation without JWKS verification.

anita.p: action items (initial): ["add pre-swap JWKS handshake check in pipeline","add verifier fallback to origin JWKS fetch on unknown kid","shorten JWKS CDN TTL and add monitoring for jwks.kid mismatch"]

support-bot: draft customer message prepared in SUP-5123. Will update with timeline and mitigation summary.

tom.h: marking incident as resolved at 2771236500 after 40m of stable metrics. Leaving postmortem and support follow-ups for next shift.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC24680 - resolved (closed) after update. :white_check_mark:

anita.p: I'll follow up with PRs for the gating and the verifier fallback and update the postmortem tomorrow.

marc_r: thanks all for quick response. I'll add concrete timeline and logs to the incident doc before EOD.
